{{Otheruses|Ring}}
[[File:ElegantCombatantsRing-SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A jeweled ring]]
A '''ring''' was a decorate item worn by individuals. Members of the [[Jiivahar]] [[Species/Legends|species]] wore rings.

The [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Imperial Sector Police]] often had [[locator ring]]s, rings with a [[Locator/Legends|locator]] device that could be worn on a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid's]] finger, to keep track of suspects.<ref name="CN II">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
